summary: refactor(content-server): move feature-flags out of fxa-shared
description:
Because:
- The fxa-shared package is being emptied.
- Only the content server uses the feature-flags module.
- The Redis key is still in use, so the reader stays.

This commit:
- Ports feature-flags to server/lib/feature-flags.js in CommonJS.
- Moves the unit test to server/lib/feature-flags.test.js.
- Requires the moved module in route-definition-index.js.
- Deletes the fxa-shared module, CLI, schema, README and tests.
- Removes the featureFlags barrel key and two package.json exports.

Closes FXA-10659
